title: Implement authentication and authorization for FastAPI endpoints
problem_statement: Current FastAPI routes in utils/context_vault.py lack explicit security controls, risking unauthorized access.
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized users may access sensitive data or operations, leading to data breaches and compliance violations.
suggested_approach: Integrate OAuth2 or JWT-based authentication middleware; enforce role-based access controls on routes.
success_criteria: All API endpoints require valid authentication tokens.
Role-based access control enforced per endpoint.

provenance.evidence: FastAPI routes detected without visible auth enforcement.

title: Refactor agent modules to reduce tight coupling
problem_statement: High import counts and dependencies among agent modules increase complexity and reduce maintainability.
risk_if_unaddressed: Complex interdependencies may cause regression risks and slow down development velocity.
suggested_approach: Analyze dependency graph; apply modularization and interface segregation; introduce dependency injection where applicable.
success_criteria: Reduced import counts per module by at least 30%.

provenance.evidence: 11 imports detected; similar patterns in other agent modules.

title: Establish automated test coverage and CI pipeline
problem_statement: No explicit test routes or test modules detected, risking undetected regressions and low reliability.
risk_if_unaddressed: Lack of automated testing may cause production defects and slow feedback cycles.
suggested_approach: Create unit and integration tests for critical modules; integrate tests into CI pipeline defined in .deliveryos/pipeline/pipeline_spec.yaml.
success_criteria: Test coverage above 80% for core modules.
CI pipeline runs tests on every commit.

provenance.evidence: Pipeline spec present but no test stage explicitly detected.
